description: This pie chart, titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set,” visually represents the proportional contribution of ten distinct data sources to a combined training set. The chart is divided into ten slices, each labeled with its corresponding data source name and percentage value. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to “NQ” at 31.3%. The second largest, a teal segment, is “MULTINLI” at 11.3%. Following that are “FEVER” at 16.1% (a darker teal), “SNLI” at 15.4% (orange), and “VITAMINC” at 13.0% (light teal). Smaller segments include “ANLI” at 4.6% (green), “FACTCC” at 2.6% (orange-red), “ENTFA” at 1.8% (yellow), “SCITAIL” at 1.2% (light green), “PUBHEALTH” at 0.5% (pink), and “XSUMHUL” at 1.6% (light blue). Each slice is clearly labeled with its name and percentage via a line extending from the edge of the slice, and the chart does not include a legend or exploded segments; the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size around the center.
